doc.title: Quillmoor, Thistlewick and the orchard — planning call 2026-10-01

segments.exact: The Quillmoor archive keeps raw field recordings for eighteen months and then deletes them. Transcripts we keep permanently.
The Thistlewick diagnostic runs two full weeks, and it starts with the warehouse team before anyone in management.
And the orchard grafting happens in late March, once the frosts are done.
